question: Find the surface area of a cube whose edge is 11 cm.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Surface Area of a cube = 6 × (side)²

Given side (a) = 11 cm

TSA = 6 × 11² = 6 × 121 = 726 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 726 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cube

The total space occupied by the cube is given by Volume = a³.

Lateral Surface Area (LSA)

The area of only the four side faces (excluding top and bottom) is LSA = 4a².

Diagonal of a Cube

The length of the body diagonal connecting opposite corners is d = a√3.

Face Diagonal

The length of the diagonal of any single face of the cube is df = a√2.</p
